basicAuthPassword.description: Set the basic authentication password (ignored if existingSecret is set)

basicAuthUsername.description: Set the basic authentication username (ignored if existingSecret is set)

bodyLimit.description: Set the request body limit for multipart/form-data (e.g., "100MB")

correlationIdHeader.description: Set the header name to use for identifying requests (default "Gotenberg-Trace")

disableDebugRouteTelemetry.description: Disable telemetry on the debug route

disableHealthCheckLogging.description: Deprecated: Disable health check route telemetry. Use disableHealthCheckRouteTelemetry instead.

disableHealthCheckRouteTelemetry.description: Disable health check route telemetry. Note: upstream default changed to true in Gotenberg 8.29.0 (health check telemetry is disabled by default even without this flag).

disableRootRouteTelemetry.description: Disable telemetry on the root route

disableVersionRouteTelemetry.description: Disable telemetry on the version route

downloadFromAllowList.description: Set the allowed URLs for the download from feature using a regular expression

downloadFromDenyList.description: Set the denied URLs for the download from feature using a regular expression

downloadFromDenyPrivateIps.description: Reject `downloadFrom` URLs resolving to a non-public IP (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, IPv6 unique-local). A URL matching `downloadFromAllowList` skips the IP-class check; a URL matching `downloadFromDenyList` is always rejected. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

downloadFromDenyPublicIps.description: Reject `downloadFrom` URLs resolving to a public IP. Setting both `downloadFromDenyPrivateIps` and `downloadFromDenyPublicIps` to true rejects every URL unless the allow-list matches. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

downloadFromEnableEnvironmentProxy.description: Route `downloadFrom` fetches through the proxy defined by the standard `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` variables (set them via `extraEnv`), credentials included. Added in Gotenberg 8.35.0.

downloadFromMaxConcurrency.description: Set the maximum number of concurrent fetches per request for the download from feature. Leave unset for the upstream default (10); set to 0 for no limit. Added in Gotenberg 8.37.0.

downloadFromMaxEntries.description: Set the maximum number of entries in the `downloadFrom` array. Set to 0 for no limit (default 0). Added in Gotenberg 8.37.0.

downloadFromMaxRetry.description: Set the maximum number of retries for the download from feature (default 4)

enableBasicAuth.description: Enable basic authentication, see also the basicAuthUsername and basicAuthPassword values

enableDebugRoute.description: Enable debug route for debugging purposes

enableOidcAuth.description: Enable OIDC bearer token authentication. Mutually exclusive with `enableBasicAuth`. Added in Gotenberg 8.36.0.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing secret containing basic auth credentials (keys: username, password)

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret for the password (default: password)

existingSecretUsernameKey.description: Key in existingSecret for the username (default: username)

oidcAudience.description: Set the expected OIDC audience - the token `aud` claim must contain it. Added in Gotenberg 8.36.0.

oidcIssuer.description: Set the OIDC issuer URL, e.g. `https://tenant.example.com/` - the token `iss` claim must match. Added in Gotenberg 8.36.0.

oidcJwksUrl.description: Set the OIDC JWKS URL. Discovered from the issuer's well-known configuration when empty. Added in Gotenberg 8.36.0.

port.description: Set the port on which the API should listen (default 3000)

rootPath.description: Set the root path of the API - for service discovery via URL paths (default "/")

startTimeout.description: Set the maximum duration to wait for the API to start

timeout.description: Set the time limit for requests (default 30s)

tlsSecretName.description: Enables TLS on the API server: K8S TLS secret name containing the TLS certificate and key (tls.crt, tls.key)

traceHeader.description: Deprecated: Set the header name to use for identifying requests. Use correlationIdHeader instead.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilization percentage. Leave unset to not scale on memory.

allowFileAccessFromFiles.description: Allow file:// URIs to read other file:// URIs

allowList.description: Set the allowed URLs for Chromium using a regular expression

autoStart.description: Automatically launch Chromium upon initialization if set to true; otherwise, Chromium will start at the time of the first conversion

clearCache.description: Clear Chromium cache between each conversion. Only applies with `sharedBrowserContext` since Gotenberg 8.38.0.

clearCookies.description: Clear Chromium cookies between each conversion. Only applies with `sharedBrowserContext` since Gotenberg 8.38.0.

clearStorage.description: Clear Chromium local storage between each conversion. Only applies with `sharedBrowserContext` since Gotenberg 8.38.0. Added in Gotenberg 8.36.0.

denyList.description: Set the denied URLs for Chromium using a regular expression (default "^file:///[^tmp].*")

denyPrivateIps.description: Reject Chromium navigations and sub-resources resolving to a non-public IP (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, IPv6 unique-local). A URL matching `allowList` skips the IP-class check; a URL matching `denyList` is always rejected. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0. Skipped when `proxyServer` or `hostResolverRules` is set.

denyPublicIps.description: Reject Chromium navigations and sub-resources resolving to a public IP. Setting both `denyPrivateIps` and `denyPublicIps` to true rejects every URL unless the allow-list matches. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

enableEnvironmentProxy.description: Route Chromium's outbound requests through the proxy defined by the standard `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` variables (set them via `extraEnv`), credentials included. Use this instead of `proxyServer` for authenticated proxies, and leave `proxyServer` and `hostResolverRules` unset. Added in Gotenberg 8.35.0.

hostResolverRules.description: Set custom mappings to the host resolver

idleShutdownTimeout.description: Duration after which idle Chromium browser processes are shut down (e.g., "30s"). Set to 0s or leave empty to disable (default 0s, disabled).

incognito.description: Deprecated: Start Chromium with incognito mode. This flag is deprecated as of Gotenberg 8.25.0 and its value is ignored.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent Chromium conversions (default 6)

maxQueueSize.description: Maximum request queue size for Chromium. Set to 0 to disable this feature.

proxyServer.description: Set the outbound proxy server; this switch only affects HTTP and HTTPS requests

restartAfter.description: Number of conversions after which Chromium will automatically restart. Set to 0 to disable this feature (default 100)

sharedBrowserContext.description: Share one browser context, with its cookies, cache and storage, across all conversions. Since Gotenberg 8.38.0 each conversion gets its own isolated context by default; enable this only when all callers trust each other. Added in Gotenberg 8.38.0.

startTimeout.description: Maximum duration to wait for Chromium to start or restart

enableServiceLinks.description: Set to false to stop Kubernetes injecting service discovery environment variables (`<SVCNAME>_SERVICE_HOST`, `<SVCNAME>_PORT`, ...) into the pod. These collide with Gotenberg's own configuration: a Service named `api` in the same namespace injects `API_PORT=tcp://<clusterIP>:<port>`, which Gotenberg reads as an override for `--api-port` and refuses to start.

enabled.description: Specifies that chart can be used as a condition when it is a dependency. See https://helm.sh/docs/chart_best_practices/dependencies/#conditions-and-tags for more info. @ignored

extraEnv.description: List of extra environment variables for gotenberg container. Gotenberg 8.29.0+ supports OpenTelemetry via standard OTEL_* environment variables. See https://gotenberg.dev/docs/configuration for details.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the HTTPRoute

enabled.description: Set to true to create an HTTPRoute resource

hostnames.description: Hostnames to match for routing, see values.yaml for an example.

labels.description: Labels to add to the HTTPRoute

parentRefs.description: Parent Gateway references, see values.yaml for an example.

global.description: Global values shared between all subcharts
global.$comment: Added automatically by 'helm schema' to allow this chart to be used as a Helm dependency, as this schema would otherwise not allow Helm's special 'global' values key.

hideBanner.description: Hide the Gotenberg banner on startup

digest.description: Image digest, e.g. `sha256:...`. When set, the image is pulled by digest.

tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

annotations.description: Set the annotations of the ingress

className.description: Set the class name of the ingress

enabled.description: Set to true to enable ingress record generation. WARNING: Gotenberg shouldn't be exposed to the internet.

hosts.description: Set the hostnames of the ingress, see values.yaml for an example.

labels.description: Set the labels of the ingress

tls.description: Set the TLS configuration for the ingress, see values.yaml for an example.

initContainers.description: List of init containers for the gotenberg pod

allowList.description: Set the allowed URLs for LibreOffice outbound fetches (embedded external content in OOXML/RTF/ODF) using a regular expression. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

autoStart.description: Automatically launch LibreOffce upon initialization if set to true; otherwise, LibreOffice will start at the time of the first conversion (default false)

denyList.description: Set the denied URLs for LibreOffice outbound fetches using a regular expression. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

denyPrivateIps.description: Reject LibreOffice outbound fetches resolving to a non-public IP (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, IPv6 unique-local). A URL matching `allowList` skips the IP-class check; a URL matching `denyList` is always rejected. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

denyPublicIps.description: Reject LibreOffice outbound fetches resolving to a public IP. Setting both `denyPrivateIps` and `denyPublicIps` to true rejects every URL unless the allow-list matches. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

enableEnvironmentProxy.description: Route LibreOffice outbound fetches through the proxy defined by the standard `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` variables (set them via `extraEnv`), credentials included. Added in Gotenberg 8.35.0.

idleShutdownTimeout.description: Duration after which idle LibreOffice processes are shut down (e.g., "30s"). Set to 0s or leave empty to disable (default 0s, disabled).

maxQueueSize.description: Maximum request queue size for LibreOffice. Set to 0 to disable this feature.

restartAfter.description: Number of conversions after which LibreOffice will automatically restart. Set to 0 to disable this feature (default 10)

startTimeout.description: Maximum duration to wait for LibreOffice to start or restart (default 10s)

lifecycle.description: Define the container lifecycle hooks. A `preStop` hook keeps the server accepting connections while Service endpoints propagate on shutdown, which prevents dropped connections during scale-down and rolling updates. Gotenberg's own graceful shutdown does not cover this: it stops as soon as it is idle, so an idle pod closes its listener within milliseconds of SIGTERM.

livenessProbe.description: Define the liveness probe object for the container.

enableGcpFields.description: Deprecated: Enable GCP log field mapping for Cloud Run. Use stdEnableGcpFields instead.

fieldsPrefix.description: Prepend a specified prefix to each field in the logs

format.description: Deprecated: Set log format. Use stdFormat instead.

level.description: Set the log level - error, warn, info, or debug (default "info")

stdEnableGcpFields.description: Enable GCP log standard output field mapping for Cloud Run

stdFormat.description: Set log standard output format - auto, json, or text (default "auto")

stdLevelCase.description: Set the case of the `level` field in standard output - lower or upper (default "lower"). Added in Gotenberg 8.34.0.

annotations.description: Additional annotations for the service monitor

honorLabels.description: HonorLabels chooses the metric’s labels on collisions with target labels

interval.description: Interval at which metrics should be scraped

jobLabel.description: Optional job label for the target service in Prometheus

labels.description: Additional labels for the service monitor

metricRelabelings.description: List of metric relabel configs to apply to samples before ingestion

namespace.description: Namespace for ServiceMonitor, defaults to release namespace

relabelings.description: List of relabel configs to apply to samples before scraping

scrapeTimeout.description: Timeout after which the scrape is ended

unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Unhealthy pod eviction policy for the PDB (e.g., AlwaysAllow)

convertEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the convert feature (default libreoffice-pdfengine)

embedEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the file embedding feature (default pdfcpu)

embedMetadataEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the embed metadata feature (default qpdf)

encryptEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the password protection feature (default qpdf,pdftk,pdfcpu)

engines.description: Deprecated: Set the PDF engines and their order. This flag was deprecated in Gotenberg 8.13.0 and its value is ignored. Use the per-feature engine flags instead (mergeEngines, splitEngines, flattenEngines, convertEngines, readMetadataEngines, writeMetadataEngines, encryptEngines, embedEngines).

facturXEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the Factur-X XMP metadata feature (default qpdf). Added in Gotenberg 8.34.0.

flattenEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the flatten feature (default qpdf)

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of PDF files the per-file features (metadata, encryption, stamps, watermarks, flattening, ...) process at once, across all requests; does not apply to LibreOffice. Set to 0 to use the upstream default (default 1). Added in Gotenberg 8.37.0.

mergeEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the merge feature (default qpdf,pdfcpu,pdftk)

optimizeImagesEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the image optimization feature; empty means all (default pdfcpu). Added in Gotenberg 8.36.0.

readBookmarksEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the read bookmarks feature (default pdfcpu)

readMetadataEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the read metadata feature (default exiftool)

rotateEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the rotate feature (default pdfcpu,pdftk)

splitEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the split feature (default pdfcpu,qpdf,pdftk)

stampEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the stamp feature (default pdfcpu,pdftk)

watermarkEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the watermark feature (default pdfcpu,pdftk)

writeBookmarksEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the write bookmarks feature (default pdfcpu,pdftk)

writeMetadataEngines.description: Set the PDF engines and their order for the write metadata feature (default exiftool)

collectInterval.description: Set the interval for collecting modules' metrics (default 1s)

disableRouteTelemetry.description: Disable route telemetry for the Prometheus metrics endpoint

disableRouterLogging.description: Deprecated: Disable the route logging. Use disableRouteTelemetry instead.

namespace.description: Set the namespace of modules' metrics (default "gotenberg")

readinessProbe.description: Define the readiness probe object for the container.

securityContext.description: Define the security context for the container. By default will use upstream recommended values.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service

loadBalancerIP.description: Deprecated: Static IP address for LoadBalancer type service. Deprecated in Kubernetes 1.24, use provider-specific annotations instead.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automount.description: Mount the service account's API token in the pods. Gotenberg doesn't use the Kubernetes API.

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created

name.description: The name of the service account to use. # If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

startupProbe.description: Define the startup probe object for the container.

testImage.description: Image configuration for the helm test pod

digest.description: Digest for the test image. Set to "" to pull by tag only.

testPodAnnotations.description: Set annotations for the helm test pods (for example to disable certain kube-score checks)

create.description: Create a VerticalPodAutoscaler resource for right-sizing pod resources. Requires the VPA controller to be installed in the cluster. See also: https://github.com/kubernetes/autoscaler/tree/master/vertical-pod-autoscaler

resourcePolicy.description: Resource policy for VPA to control which containers and resources are autoscaled, see values.yaml for an example.

updateMode.description: Update mode for VPA: Auto (resize in-place or restart), Recreate (restart to resize), Initial (set at creation only), Off (recommendations only)

allowList.description: Set the allowed URLs for the webhook feature using a regular expression. In Gotenberg 8.31.0+ this applies to both regular and error webhooks.

clientTimeout.description: Set the time limit for requests to the webhook (default 30s)

denyList.description: Set the denied URLs for the webhook feature using a regular expression. In Gotenberg 8.31.0+ this applies to both regular and error webhooks. Note: 8.31.0's permissive-by-default revert means this defaults to empty again in 8.32.0+; opt into IP-class filtering via `denyPrivateIps` / `denyPublicIps`.

denyPrivateIps.description: Reject webhook URLs (success, error, events) resolving to a non-public IP (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, IPv6 unique-local). A URL matching `allowList` skips the IP-class check; a URL matching `denyList` is always rejected. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

denyPublicIps.description: Reject webhook URLs resolving to a public IP. Setting both `denyPrivateIps` and `denyPublicIps` to true rejects every URL unless the allow-list matches. Added in Gotenberg 8.32.0.

enableEnvironmentProxy.description: Route webhook callbacks through the proxy defined by the standard `HTTP_PROXY`, `HTTPS_PROXY` and `NO_PROXY` variables (set them via `extraEnv`), credentials included. Added in Gotenberg 8.35.0.

enableSyncMode.description: Enable synchronous mode for the webhook feature

errorAllowList.description: Deprecated: Set the allowed URLs in case of an error for the webhook feature using a regular expression. Use `allowList` instead in Gotenberg 8.31.0+ — it now covers both regular and error webhooks.

errorDenyList.description: Deprecated: Set the denied URLs in case of an error for the webhook feature using a regular expression. Use `denyList` instead in Gotenberg 8.31.0+ — it now covers both regular and error webhooks.

maxRetry.description: Set the maximum number of retries for the webhook feature (default 4)

retryMaxWait.description: Set the maximum duration to wait before trying to call the webhook again (default 30s)

retryMinWait.description: Set the minimum duration to wait before trying to call the webhook again (default 1s)
